zh: /new [标题]  开启一个全新会话（可指定标题）
/fork [标题]  从当前会话分支一个新会话（默认沿用父会话标题加“ (fork)”）
/compact  压缩当前会话的较早上下文
/clear  清空当前会话上下文（保留 Session 绑定和历史记录）
/history [数量]  查看最近历史消息（默认 3 条，最多 5 条）
/workspace 或 /ws  查看可切换的工作区（点按钮切换）
/workspace 工作区序号或绝对路径  切换工作区
/conv 或 /conversation  查看当前对话工作区
/conv 工作区绝对路径或序号  设置当前对话专属工作区
/conv clear  清除专属工作区，回到 bot 默认工作区
/workspacelist、/wsl、/workspaces  工作区列表别名（等同 /ws）
/sessionlist 或 /sessions [工作区序号或绝对路径]  列出会话 ID 和标题
/sessionlist --limit N  仅列出当前工作区前 N 个会话
/session Session ID 或当前工作区序号  将当前聊天绑定到指定会话
/ls 或 /list  列出本聊天使用过的会话（● 当前，←/→ 可前后切换，✕ 已失效；列表按聊天隔离，论坛群按话题）
/go 会话编号  切换到该会话（编号见 /ls）
/prev  回到上一个会话
/next  前进到下一个会话
/drop 会话编号  从本聊天会话列表移除该条记录（不删除 Harness 会话）
/title  查看当前会话标题
/title 新标题  重命名当前会话
/title 会话编号 新标题  重命名指定会话
/tail 或 /peek [编号] [条数]  预览最近消息（默认 5 条，仅提问与回答）
/tail 或 /peek [编号] file  导出整个会话为 Markdown 文件
/models  按序号列出所有可用模型
/reasoninglist 或 /reasonings  按序号列出当前模型可用推理等级
/reasoning [序号、等级ID或 --default]  查看或切换当前推理等级
/model [序号或完整模型ID] [推理等级ID]  查看或切换当前会话模型
示例：先发 /models，再发 /model 2 [推理等级ID]
/presetlist 或 /presets  按序号列出可用 Agent Preset
/preset [序号或完整ID]  查看或设置当前机器人 Agent Preset
纯数字 ID：/preset id:<ID>
/preset --default  跟随 Host 默认
/stop  停止当前任务
/steer 补充指令  纠偏当前任务
/batch  开始批量输入（仅私聊，最多 10 条文字）
/send  提交当前批次
/cancel  取消当前批次
/status  检查连接状态
/version  查看插件版本
/help  显示本帮助
en: /new [title]  Start a brand-new session (optionally titled)
/fork [title]  Branch a new session from the current one (default: parent title + " (fork)")
/compact  Compact the earlier context of the current session
/clear  Clear the current session context (keep the Session binding and history)
/history [count]  Preview recent messages (default 3, maximum 5)
/workspace or /ws  View switchable Workspaces (tap a button to switch)
/workspace <workspace index or absolute path>  Switch workspace
/conv or /conversation  Show the workspace of this conversation
/conv <workspace absolute path or index>  Set a workspace dedicated to this conversation
/conv clear  Clear the dedicated workspace and fall back to the bot default
/workspacelist, /wsl, /workspaces  Workspace-list aliases (same as /ws)
/sessionlist or /sessions [workspace index or absolute path]  List session IDs and titles
/sessionlist --limit N  List only the first N sessions in the current workspace
/session <Session ID or workspace index>  Bind this chat to the specified session
/ls or /list  List this chat's sessions (● current, ←/→ navigate, ✕ unavailable; the list is per chat, and per topic in forum groups)
/go <number>  Switch to that session (numbers in /ls)
/prev  Go back to the previous session
/next  Go forward to the next session
/drop <number>  Remove that entry from this chat's session list (the Harness session is not deleted)
/title  Show the current session title
/title <new title>  Rename the current session
/title <number> <new title>  Rename that session
/tail or /peek [number] [count]  Preview recent messages (default 5; prompts and answers only)
/tail or /peek [number] file  Export the whole session as a Markdown file
/models  List all available models by index
/reasoninglist or /reasonings  List reasoning efforts for the current model by index
/reasoning [index, effort ID, or --default]  Show or switch the current reasoning effort
/model [index or full model ID] [reasoning effort ID]  Show or switch the current Session model
Example: send /models first, then /model 2 [reasoning effort ID]
/presetlist or /presets  List available Agent Presets by index
/preset [index or full ID]  Show or set the Agent Preset of this bot
Numeric-only ID: /preset id:<ID>
/preset --default  Follow the Host default
/stop  Stop the current task
/steer <additional instruction>  Steer the current task
/batch  Start batch input (direct messages only, up to 10 text messages)
/send  Submit the current batch
/cancel  Cancel the current batch
/status  Check the connection status
/version  Show the plugin version
/help  Show this help
